department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
beneficiary: Adult women from eligible poor households
benefits: Free first refill(s) and two-burner stove as specified under PMUY 2.0
eligibility: Applicant must be a woman aged 18 years or above
Applicant must belong to a poor household based on the prescribed deprivation declaration
There must be no existing LPG connection in the household in the name of a family member listed in the family composition document
required_documents: Ration card or other state government document showing family composition
Aadhaar of adult family members listed in family document
application_process: Apply through an LPG distributor or the official online PMUY application process.
source_type: Official PMUY portal, Government of India
